title: Nitrogen Oxides (NOx)
description: Near surface concentration of nitrogen oxides (NOx) estimated by NASA's GEOS-CF model.

mp4.note: The MP4 starts 24 h after the PNG frames (verified against the burned-in date).

colorbar.note: x1 is exclusive. Pixels 70-71 and 464-465 are a white border. Logarithmic: labels 1e-3..1e1 sit at x 68/176/279/358/439 (centre of the '10' glyph in NOx_colorbar.png, +-3 px; the decades are not evenly spaced). The top value 22 is extrapolated to the bar end (x 467); it is not labelled.

encoding.model: pixel = a(v)*colorbar(v) + (1-a(v))*background, background = greyscale Earth (black ocean)
encoding.note: Opacity measured from PNG frames over ocean (interpolated in log10). Values below ~0.002 ppbv are drawn transparent (black ocean, grey land, white ice) and decode to ~0.001. Grids store log10(value): value = 10 ** (offset + byte * scale).

disclaimer: Values are decoded from visualization colours (approximate), not raw science data.
